turns.content:
I have fixed the issue where decimal numbers were being rejected by the parser.

The root cause was in the `calc/grammar.lark` file, where the `NUMBER` terminal was defined as `/[0-9]+/`, which only matched integers. I updated the regex to `/[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?/` to correctly support decimal numbers.

After updating the grammar and regenerating the parser using `make gen`, the `test_decimals` test passed successfully.
